Meta.tagline: Plan your move with real numbers.
Meta.description: Compare cost of living, match your degree to in-demand jobs, and read visa guides for the country you want to move to.

Home.title: Move abroad on numbers, not guesswork.
Home.subtitle: Compare what life actually costs, see which jobs want your diploma, and know the visa you need — in English or Arabic.
Home.featuresSubtitle: Everything you need to shortlist a destination before you commit.
Home.f1Body: Put two countries side by side: rent, groceries, utilities, transport and average net salary — with a verdict on how far your income stretches.
Home.f2Body: Pick your education level and field. See the roles that accept it, their demand level, salary range, and whether employers sponsor visas.
Home.f3Body: Per-country visa routes, document checklists, processing times and costs — written to be read, not decoded.
Home.how1: Tell us where you are and where you're thinking of going.
Home.how2: Check whether your income and your diploma actually work there.
Home.how3: Follow the visa route that fits your situation.
Home.popularSubtitle: Start from one of the most-searched routes.
